stock.description: Zhuguang Holdings Group Company Limited operates as an investment holding entity primarily focused on a range of real estate activities across the People's Republic of China. Its comprehensive scope encompasses the creation, acquisition, administration, disposition, and tenancy of property assets. The enterprise structures its operations across three principal divisions: Property Development, Project Management Services, and Property Investment. Within its development arm, the firm constructs and markets a diverse range of properties, alongside managing hotel establishments. Furthermore, it delivers specialized project management solutions for both new construction endeavors and urban renewal schemes, while also allocating capital to property investments. Incorporated in 1996, the company's corporate headquarters are situated in Central, Hong Kong, and it functions as a subsidiary of Rong De Investment Limited.
